We are a leading international supplier of equipment and services to global freight transportation markets. Through our wholly-owned subsidiaries and consolidated and unconsolidated joint ventures, we design, build and market freight railcars in North America, Europe and Brazil. We are a leading provider of freight railcar wheel services, component parts, maintenance and sustainable conversion services in North America. We own a lease fleet of railcars that originate primarily from our manufacturing operations. We offer railcar management, regulatory compliance services and leasing services to railroads and other railcar owners in North America.
We operate an integrated business model that combines freight car manufacturing, wheel services, railcar maintenance, component parts, leasing and fleet management services. Our model is designed to provide customers with a comprehensive set of freight car product and service solutions by utilizing our substantial engineering, mechanical and technical capabilities, as well as our experienced commercial personnel. Our integrated model allows us to develop cross-selling opportunities and synergies among our reportable segments thereby enhancing our margins. We believe our integrated model is difficult to duplicate and provides greater value for our customers and investors.
Effective September 1, 2025, we changed our measurement basis for allocating revenue and expenses associated with syndication activity between the Manufacturing and Leasing & Fleet Management reportable segments. This change reflects the information currently provided to our chief operating decision maker (CODM) to assess performance and allocate resources and had no impact on our consolidated results of operations or financial position. Prior period segment results have been recast to conform to the current period presentation. See Note 16 – Segment Information to the Consolidated Financial Statements for additional information on our reportable segments.

North American Manufacturing - We manufacture a broad range of freight railcar types used in the North American market. We also place railcars on lease to customers and sell the railcars with leases attached to investors (syndicate railcars). We continue to develop product features and capabilities based on customer and market requirements. The primary products we produce for the North American market are:
Freight Railcars - We manufacture a variety of covered hopper cars used to transport food-grade products, grain, fertilizer, cement, minerals and plastic pellets, as well as gondolas and open-top hoppers for steel, metals, scrap and aggregates. We also produce boxcars for the transportation of paper products, perishables and general merchandise. Our flat car offerings include center partition cars for forest products and heavy-duty flat cars.
Tank Cars - We manufacture a variety of tank cars, including general-purpose, pressurized, coiled, lined, insulated and stainless-steel designs. These railcars are used to transport hazardous and non-hazardous commodities, including petroleum products, ethanol, liquefied petroleum gas, petrochemicals, caustic soda, chlorine, fertilizers, vegetable oils, biodiesel and other products.
Intermodal Railcars - We manufacture a portfolio of intermodal railcars, including our Maxi-Stack® I and Maxi-Stack® IV double-stack railcars. These railcars are designed to transport containers stacked two-high on a single platform.
Automotive - We manufacture railcar equipment designed for the transportation of light vehicles. Our automotive offerings include the Auto-Max® II, Multi-Max TM and Multi-Max Plus TM products, which are designed to transport automobiles, CUVs, SUVs, trucks and high-sided vans.
Sustainable Conversions TM - We provide railcar conversion services that repurpose existing railcars for alternative service applications. These services include rebodying or stretching covered hoppers for larger cubic-capacity service, re-racking or converting autoracks and performing tank car retrofits to address regulatory requirements.
Component Parts - Our component parts facilities manufacture and recondition railcar components, including cushioning units, couplers, yokes, bolsters, gates, valves and other parts.
Wheel Services - We operate wheel service facilities in North America that provide wheel and axle reconditioning services, as well as new axle machining, finishing and downsizing.
